sections.what: Imports the test tools, the grading functions, the match parser, the outcome model functions and the option functions. Reads no data at this point.

sections.name: grader
sections.title: Grading rules and real-moment check
sections.what: Checks that read points are the chosen option's win probability minus the best other option, in points. Checks the two-point coin-flip band, rejects bad inputs, and checks Brier arithmetic. Grades a real 2017 chase moment with 36 balls left, checks each option's read points, keeps the grade provisional, and withholds the grade when data is insufficient.
sections.why: Likely reason: fans see grades in points, so the points must match the model's numbers exactly, and provisional marking prevents overclaiming.
sections.watch_out: The coin-flip band is set to two points in these tests. Changing it changes which picks count as wins.

summary: Checks how a pick is graded: the read points gap, the coin-flip rule, input rejection, the Brier score, and the grade of a real 2017 chase moment.
purpose: Makes sure a fan's call is graded correctly and that a graded real moment is always labelled provisional.
why: Likely reason: grades are only useful if the arithmetic is right and the uncertainty is clearly marked.
how: Checks grade on small examples, the coin-flip band, bad input errors, and Brier arithmetic. Then loads the committed outcome and option models and one real match, builds the decision for 36 balls left, and checks that each option's read points equals its gap to the best other option.
inputs: Synthetic option probabilities, data/models/outcomes-v1.json, data/models/options-v1.json, and the fixture data/fixtures/cricsheet/1082625.json.
risks: The real-moment test depends on several saved files. The provisional label must not be removed without validation.
debug: If the real-moment test fails, check that the fixture and both model files are present, then compare the read points with the decision's option probabilities.
